main_text.head: CAP. III.
Objectiones Pontificiorum ex Patribus.
main_text.p: Pontificios ex Græcis Patribus violenter extorquere nomen MERITI.
main_text.head: SECT. I.
main_text.p: Bellarm. lib.5. de Ju-stif. cap.4.INcipit {1}Cardinalis à Græcis Pa-tribus, sed plurimi ex nostris partibus sæpe multúmque con-questi sunt de Pontificiorum Versionibus, ceu improbis, vel ignaris: qui ex Græcis sententiis bonis reddidé-runt Latinas non bonas, ut hoc pacto saltem nomen MERITI extraherent.

I.Primus Pater ab eo laudatus est Ignatius in Epist. ad Rom. Sinite me, ut bestiarum esca sim, per quam possim Deum promereri. Ubi Græca vox [ἐπιτυχῶν][?] quæ est consequi aut adipisci, Latinè coactè vertitur, Promereri.
II.Secundus est Justinus Martyr Apolog.2. circa medium, in hunc modum; Homines se dignos

page.notes: The superscript "1" after "Cardinalis" has no matching footnote on this page; it is transcribed as a reference mark, and the margin note is given the same mark. The margin note's own mark is faint and may be an asterisk rather than "1". The Greek word in brackets is uncertain and marked [?]. The first line of the page's text is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The catchword "Deo" is set at the lower right and is kept out of the text.
